FAQ

Questions about pg & co-living software

Short, direct answers.

How can a PG owner collect rent on time?

Automate invoices, send WhatsApp reminders before and after the due date and offer UPI links. Sarvlekh does this automatically and reconciles payments so you never chase tenants manually.

Does it split electricity bills fairly?

Yes. Enter meter readings and Sarvlekh divides the bill by room occupancy and days stayed, producing a statement tenants can see.

Can I list vacant beds online?

Yes. A branded listing page and enquiry CRM are included so vacancies turn into visits.

Can the pg & co-living system be customised to our way of working?

Yes. Every Sarvlekh system is shaped around your workflow — modules, roles, reports and approvals are configured with you, not imposed on you.

Can Sarvlekh connect the pg & co-living system to Tally and GST?

Yes. Sales, purchase and payment entries flow into Tally automatically and GST-ready invoices are generated from the same data.

How quickly can we go live?

A focused first release usually goes live in weeks. We start with the modules that remove the most manual work and expand in stages.
